title: Forte 47 Gran Turismo Set for Grand Premiere at Cannes 2026
description: Discover the Forte 47 Gran Turismo, a "mini superyacht" launching at Cannes Yachting Festival 2026, offering luxurious living and impressive speed.
html:
Ameglia-Based Forte Yachts Prepares to Showcase Its Innovative 14.35-Metre Model

The maritime world eagerly anticipates the debut of the Forte 47 Gran Turismo, an exceptional 14.35-metre yacht from Ameglia-based Forte Yachts, slated to premiere at the prestigious Cannes Yachting Festival in 2026. This full aluminium model has successfully completed its sea trials, impressively achieving a top speed of 47 knots, signaling its readiness to redefine luxury and performance in its class. Crafted with a beam of 4.5 meters and a shallow draft of 0.85 meters, the Forte 47 Gran Turismo is the culmination of a collaborative effort between leading designers and engineers. Paolo Giordano Yacht Design meticulously shaped the yacht’s compelling concept, exterior lines, and sophisticated interiors. Concurrently, the naval architecture and detailed engineering were expertly handled by Umberto Tagliavini Marine Design, working in conjunction with West Navaltech, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and robust performance.

Forte Yachts has positioned the Forte 47 Gran Turismo as a ‘mini superyacht,’ a testament to its best-in-class liveability, boasting over 40 square meters of expansive outdoor living space complemented by generously proportioned interiors. A standout feature is the ingenious fold-down side wings, which, when deployed at anchor, transform the cockpit into a vast open platform seamlessly connected to the water. This area encompasses a comfortable lounge, a large sofa, and a versatile transformable table, all sheltered under a stylish hardtop. A well-appointed kitchen island further enhances the onboard entertaining possibilities.

Evenings aboard the Forte 47 Gran Turismo promise cinematic experiences, with a large flatscreen TV silently ascending from behind the pilot seats, complete with discreetly hidden speakers. A built-in fridge and icemaker within the bar ensure refreshments are always within reach. The vessel also provides ample sunbathing areas both aft and forward, while the helm station is strategically placed to starboard, offering unobstructed access to the foredeck and down to the guest cabins.

Below deck, the yacht offers luxurious accommodation for up to five guests across two meticulously designed suites. The amidships cabin accommodates three, while the owner’s foreword suite comfortably sleeps two. Each cabin benefits from dedicated bathrooms and wardrobes, a rare and highly prized feature in this segment, as noted by designer Paolo Giordano. This thoughtful layout provides exceptional headroom and storage, appealing to both younger owners and families seeking comfort and privacy.

Powering the first Forte 47 Gran Turismo are three potent 600 hp Mercury Verado V12 outboard engines, delivering its impressive 47-knot top speed. For those prioritizing comfort with a slightly more relaxed pace, an alternative Lounge Deck version is available, equipped with Volvo Penta IPS drives, offering a top speed of 37 knots. This inboard configuration includes an additional lounge area aft and a hydraulic swim platform, further enhancing leisure opportunities. Fernando Moricca, Forte Yachts co-owner and business manager, emphasizes the shipyard’s commitment to delivering superyacht-level quality, craftsmanship, and engineering, along with extensive personalization options thanks to its all-aluminium construction.
